Engagement models

Three ways to work with us.

Pick the model that fits your stage and budget — packages above apply to project-based work.

Project-Based

A fixed scope, timeline, and price. You tell us what you need — we deliver it. No surprises.

Best for MVPs, redesigns, and one-off builds

  • Fixed scope & price
  • Milestone-based delivery
  • Detailed project roadmap
  • Dedicated project manager
Discuss your project

Monthly Retainer

Ongoing development hours with priority access. Your dedicated team, always available — for products that keep evolving.

Best for SaaS products and growing platforms

  • Guaranteed monthly hours
  • Priority support & fast turnaround
  • Continuous iteration & improvement
  • Flexible scope adjustments
Start a retainer

Team Augmentation

Our engineers join your team directly. Same tools, same standups, same goals — just more capacity when you need it.

Best for Scaling teams and filling skill gaps

  • Engineers embedded in your workflow
  • Full-time or part-time availability
  • Your tools, your processes
  • Rapid onboarding
Augment your team
